name: display_configuration
description: Rotation, geometry, touch, boot console and splash, screensaver and brightness for the screen of a Volumio x86 player
author: Balbuze, Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: One place for everything the screen of an x86 player does: the turn and mirror of every connected output, the boot console and splash turned to match, the touch and pointer matrices that follow (with an offset for controllers mounted the other way), picture fit for screens that overscan, screensaver (DPMS or xscreensaver, held off while playing), cursor hiding and backlight brightness. Settings are named profiles with backup, restore and reset. On a virtual machine it fixes the resolution the guest boots with. Display and console changes apply at once; the boot splash takes one reboot.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.1.0 - Legacy BIOS boots: the console and the boot logo now turn on players that boot through syslinux rather than GRUB, found on a Dell Latitude 3189; the Boot section names the boot path and whether the running boot carries the settings; the boot file is planned from the profile alone, so a cold start without a display no longer turns the console to normal and back.
